opening.argument: The title identifies a cover of “I Was Made For Lovin' You,” and the footage shows performers playing cello, violin, and keyboard beside sheet music. The audio discusses a second movement with double bass and asks to play a number again. These are concrete features of a musical performance, not evidence of a deceptive solicitation. Social-media and website references appear in a performance-related description, but the available video evidence does not identify any required action for viewers. On this record, the material supports a song-cover reading without establishing deception.
